owners.label: Grace of Life
owners.description: Verina protects a team member from fatal damage and grants a shield with strength equal to 120% of Verina's ATK, lasting for 10s. This can be triggered 1 time every 10 minutes.

owners.label: Gift of Nature
owners.description: When Verina casts Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish or Outro Skill Blossom, all team members' ATK are increased by 20% for 20s.

owners.label: Blossom
owners.description: Heal the incoming Resonator by 19% of Verina's ATK per second for 6s. All Resonators on nearby teams have their DMG Amplified by 15% for 30s.

owners.label: Moment of Emergence
owners.description: Outro Skill Blossom grants the next character a continuous Healing effect, recovering HP by 20% of Verina's ATK every 5s for 30s.

owners.label: Sprouting Reflections
owners.description: Resonance Skill Botany Experiment additionally grants 1 [Photosynthesis Energy] and 10 Concerto Energy.

owners.label: The Choice to Flourish
owners.description: Healing of Resonance Liberation's Photosynthesis Mark is increased by 12%.

owners.label: Blossoming Embrace
owners.description: Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-Air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish and Outro Skill Blossom increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of all team members by 15% for 24s.

owners.label: Miraculous Blooms
owners.description: When Verina heals a team member with HP less than 50%, her Healing is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Joyous Harvest
owners.description: Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms and Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms deal 20% more DMG. They will trigger Coordinated Attack 1 time and heal all characters nearby. The damage of this Coordinated Attack and the Healing are equal to those of the Resonance Liberation's Photosynthesis Mark.

owners.label: Blossom
owners.description: Verina grants Blossom to a nearby Resonator.
